name: Joshi Ryoujoku ~Ryouka Bijin Shimai Odori Gui~
original_name: 女子寮辱 ～良家美人姉妹おどり喰い～
source:
Stage is dormitory at an all-girl school. It's summer vacations, so only nine girls remain at the camp. One day criminals break into the building...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事舞台是一所女子学校的宿舍。正值暑假，只有九名少女留在宿舍中。一日，罪犯闯入了大楼……
